title: The domain is live.
body: unconventionalists.com and .co.uk are pointed at a single static page, the mail works, and a first version of the site is up within a day of starting. There are two of us and a growing number of agents.

title: A brand, a line, and this page.
body: Two days on identity: the rocket redrawn from the original sketch, a mark with two orbits, two typefaces, five colours, and the line Built so we can leave the room. Then this site, designed and built with agents, decided by people. The first scan is being set up next.
